FLORA_HAZARDS: Strangler vines drop from the canopy on anything that stops moving.
Spore clouds at dusk: a slow disease debuff unless you cover your mouth.
Pitcher pits big enough to swallow a party; the smell is the warning.
Razor grass on every open slope. Boots first, then everything else.
Sleep-flowers along the river. Whoever sleeps here doesn't wake.
Luminous fungus that marks anyone who touches it for a day. Hunters know this.
Bleeding trees; the sap is flammable and the mobs know it.
A canopy so thick the minimap loses the sky. No flight above tree level here.
RIVER_CROSSINGS: a rope ferry run by frog-folk who charge in blood-bar time
a collapsed highway bridge, passable single file
a ford that's knee-deep for exactly two hours a day
a naiad toll bridge; the toll is a secret
no crossing: swim, and the naiads decide
HUNTER_WEAPONS: railgun with a scope that sees through foliage
HUNTER_ARMOR: a shield bubble on a belt (four charges)
HUNTER_TECH: a captured Funeral Bell in a cage
a stasis cage for live captures
SPONSOR_PERKS: a one-time resurrection paid for by their home planet
daily supply drops at their camp
a shared kill-feed with every other hunter of their species
a bounty multiplier on named crawlers
a personal Syndicate camera crew (which can be followed)
a tame city-boss on a leash, once
a portal home that only opens on their death
HUNT_STYLES: Ambush predators: sit on trails between settlements and wait.
Drone-scouted sweeps; they know where you slept.
Bait safe rooms with wounded crawlers and shoot whoever comes to help.
Camp-and-patrol; they never split up and never move at night.
Trophy hunters: only interested in top-listed crawlers, ignore everyone else.
Slavers with a stasis cage; they want you alive.
Loud. Music, lights, fireworks. Want to be found.
Follow the thorn wall and shoot what it flushes.
CAMP_TYPES: a hover-yacht moored above the canopy
a cave with a portal generator
a treehouse platform ringed with sensors
BOUNTY_BOARD: trade for one item from the hunter's own loadout, or 1,000 gold
a Gold Hunter Box and a Syndicate-broadcast interview you can refuse
everything in the camp, plus the supply-drop beacon keeps working for you
one use of that hunter's sponsor perk
a permanent title, a stat token, and every hunter on the floor told your name
ransom from their home planet, paid in gear, delivered to a safe room
your gear, sold to the Faction Wars; the better your kit, the higher your price
ZOCKAU_NOTES: 1950s small-town main street under a jungle canopy; pubs, a town square, the Desperado Club at the end of the strip.
Ursine police attack crawlers on sight. Diplomatic hunters walk freely.
The stairwell in the park is unguarded, and everyone on the floor knows exactly where it is.
One real safe room on the pub strip; the rest are fronts.
